import gzip
fa={}
name=None
for line in open('read.proportions.q1.fa'):
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('>'):
        name=line[1:].split()[0]; fa[name]=''
    else: fa[name]+=line
names=list(fa)
rc=str.maketrans('ACGTNacgtn','TGCANtgcan')
def revcomp(s): return s.translate(rc)[::-1]
counts={n:0 for n in names}; unique=both=none=0; examples=[]
with gzip.open('read.proportions.q1.fq.gz','rt') as f:
    while True:
        h=f.readline()
        if not h: break
        seq=f.readline().strip(); f.readline(); f.readline()
        hits=[]
        for n in names:
            x=fa[n].find(seq); y=fa[n].find(revcomp(seq))
            if x>=0 or y>=0: hits.append(n)
        if len(hits)==1: counts[hits[0]]+=1; unique+=1
        elif len(hits)==0:
            none+=1
            if len(examples)<5: examples.append(seq)
        else: both+=1
print('names',names,'exact unique',unique,'ambiguous',both,'none',none)
print(counts)
print('examples none',examples)

import subprocess, collections
fa={}; n=None
for l in open('read.proportions.q1.fa'):
 l=l.strip()
 if l.startswith('>'): n=l[1:].split()[0]; fa[n]=''
 else: fa[n]+=l
names=list(fa); L=3000
vars=[i for i in range(L) if len({fa[n][i] for n in names})>1]
# each variable site, counts observed bases
counts={i:collections.Counter() for i in vars}
p=subprocess.Popen(['bwa','mem','-t','2','read.proportions.q1.fa','read.proportions.q1.fq.gz'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,text=True)
for line in p.stdout:
 if line.startswith('@'): continue
 f=line.rstrip().split('\\t'); flag=int(f[1])
 if flag&4 or flag&256 or flag&2048 or f[5] "'!= '"'36M': continue
 pos=int(f[3])-1; seq=f[9]
 for j,b in enumerate(seq):
  if pos+j in counts: counts[pos+j][b]+=1
p.wait()
for target in range(4):
 xs=[]; weighted=collections.Counter()
 for i in vars:
  alleles=[fa[n][i] for n in names]
  if alleles.count(alleles[target])==1:
   c=counts[i]; total=sum(c.values()); x=c[alleles[target]]/total if total else 0
   xs.append(x); weighted['num']+=c[alleles[target]]; weighted['den']+=total
 print(names[target],len(xs),'weighted',weighted['num']/weighted['den'], 'unweighted',sum(xs)/len(xs), 'range',min(xs),max(xs))
# Print selected site ratios by distinctive chrom
for i in vars:
 alleles=[fa[n][i] for n in names]
 uniq=[k for k,a in enumerate(alleles) if alleles.count(a)==1]
 if len(uniq)==1:
  c=counts[i]; t=sum(c.values()); print(i+1,''.join(alleles),names[uniq[0]],t,dict(c),round(c[alleles[uniq[0]]]/t,3))
